sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.0327/2022 registered at Police Station Khitola District Jabapur (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 3, 4, 5 & 6 of the POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 08.01.2023.
The allegation against the applicant, in short, is that he not only kidnapped the prosecutrix but also committed sexual intercourse with her.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the prosecutrix (PW2) and her mother Geetabai (PW1) both turned hostile and have not supported the prosecution story.
The applicant is ready to comply with all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering his application for grant of bail.
Trial will take time for its conclusion.

Hence, prayer is Satyam Shrivas vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116364782/
1 made to enlarge the applicant on bail.

entities.text: Satyam Shrivas vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate for the State, in his turn, opposed the bail application.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and the fact that the prosecutrix has not supported the prosecution story and totally denied the allegation against the present applicant, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to extend benefit of bail to the applicant.
Hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, this bail application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant Satyam Shrivas be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the said Court on the dates given by the concerned Court during pendency of trial.

It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
